rules: UniversalModifier: value -1..+1, default 0, weight = |value|, no extra gain, no vertex mask
One official group per part; do not mix Hip into Buttocks or Pelvis into Buttocks
Add a part as web/parts/<id>.json and list it in web/parts/manifest.json
kind=morph morphs the clay hm08 body; kind=overlay loads extra OBJ clothes
kind=body is the dummy. Clay is MakeHuman hm08
kind=hair is one code slot (color / style / shelf). Head screen shows all three rows at once in even canvas slots
kind=makeup paints official hm08 UV (default.mhmat vertexColors false). Lip/cheek pixels come from official mouth-*-lip-volume and *-cheek-volume targets, not a bounding box
kind=pose uses factory/bake_body_poses.py (mh-skinmesh-v1: body-poseunits + skeleton.skinMesh); see factory/mh/POSES.md
Eyes are official HighPolyEyes clothes, always on the dummy. helper-l-eye is a cage and is not drawn
Pages must ship the whole web/ folder; bump cache in manifest.json and all ?v= URLs together
